ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white/light grey) coverage restricted to linear scarification and surface abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of contiguous dark pigmentation; high-contrast linear and punctate white markings are distributed across the lower-medial and lateral regions of both lobes, with significant concentrations of white pixels along the upper trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees, though the vertex is partially occluded by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-frequency serration pattern characterized by numerous irregular, sharp-peaked protrusions (8-12 per lobe) and deep-cut valleys along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve with a strong upward vertical orientation toward the distal tips, resulting in an 'M' shaped profile when viewed as a whole.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white clusters present near the upper-outer margins of both the left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant density of multi-directional white linear marks; prominent diagonal rake marks on the lower left lobe and intersecting horizontal/diagonal marks on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (linear tracks) across the ventral surface and localized depigmentation/scuffing on the tips of the trailing edge serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: The highly irregular, almost 'shredded' appearance of the trailing edge topography is the most distinctive structural feature.
